positive_terms: Description of how oversight is exercised over management-level position or committee to which management's role is delegated to
治理机构对授权管理职责的监督
Description of how oversight is exercised over management-level position or committee to which management's role is delegated to。治理机构对授权管理职责的监督。治理机构成员不是员工总数；性别多样性和独立性分母、机构范围及统计时点必须明确。责任、能力和监督分别举证。
